description: This file defines internal structures, macros, and function prototypes for the Android Radio Interface Layer (RIL). It includes constants for response types, logging macros, and data structures for managing RIL requests and commands.

classes.name: RequestInfo
classes.description: Structure representing a RIL request, including token, command info pointer, request queue linkage, and status flags.

classes.name: CommandInfo
classes.description: Structure holding request number and response handling function pointer.

methods.name: addRequestToList
methods.description: Function to add a new request to the request list.

methods.name: RIL_getServiceName
methods.description: Function to retrieve the service name for a given RIL slot.

methods.name: releaseWakeLock
methods.description: Function to release the wake lock held by the RIL.

methods.name: onNewCommandConnect
methods.description: Function called when a new command connection is established.
